newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire Pacific sets HK$3.0 bln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Swire Pacific sets HK$3.0 bln FRN.

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd has launched a two-tranche floating rate note issue via its special purpose vehicle, arranger HSBC Markets said.
The deal is guaranteed by Swire Pacific Ltd.

Tranche A of HK$1.5 billion has a tenor of three years. The issue was priced at par and re-offered at a fixed 99.85. It pays a coupon of 25 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate (HIBOR). The re-offer spread is 30 basis points over HIBOR.

Tranche B of HK$1.5 billion has a tenor of five years. The issue was priced at par and re-offered at a fixed 99.825. It pays a coupon of 32.5 basis points over the three-month HIBOR. The re-offer spread is 36 basis points over HIBOR.
Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the certificates of use at its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
